messages:
Alex: heads up — main CI turned red after the deps/py-libs bump. failing tests: integration::kv_cache_eviction and integration::prefetch_race. CI link: https://ci.redwood.com/98765 :frowning:

ci-bot: Build 98765 failed on linux-x86-64. See logs: https://ci.redwood.com/job/98765/console

Maria: thanks. last green was at 1849980000 (commit 9a7c1d2). suspect the recent psutil (v5.9.1 -> 5.9.2) bump in requirements.txt

Alex: can someone kick off a rerun? maybe flake.

ci-bot: Rerun triggered by @alex. Build 98766 queued.

QA-Ron: attaching failing stack snippet: ```
AssertionError: KV cache size mismatch
File tests/integration/test_kv.py:42
Expected 512, got 0
```

Devops-Jess: if it's dep related we should bisect. Alex — can you run `git bisect` between 9a7c1d2 and HEAD? I can help with bisect runner.

Alex: starting now. steps: `git bisect start HEAD 9a7c1d2` then mark bad/good. I'll post results.

Sam: FYI there's an open PR #7834 that updated psutil and changed preload logic — probable culprit.

Alex: first bisect pass: marked 6 commits bad/good, found suspect commit bf3d2e4 (merge PR #7834). Repro locally with `tox -e integration` — failing same assertion.

Maria: can you try reverting just the psutil bump locally? `pip install psutil==5.9.1` and run tests.

Alex: did that — tests passed locally after pin. So confirmed.

Sam: OK — temporary revert PR? I'll open revert of the version change only, keep other fixes.

Devops-Jess: tagging @eng-oncall in case we need to rollback main quickly. Also schedule patch release.

Alex: created rollback PR #7841 with just requirements.txt change. CI is running.

ci-bot: Build 98770 for PR #7841 passed all integration tests.

Maria: nice. merging revert to main. After merge, please monitor /eng-oncall for any regressions.

Sam: opening follow-up issue to investigate why psutil 5.9.2 breaks preload — assign to @maria and @qa-ron.

QA-Ron: adding relevant logs and a minimized repro in the issue.

Alex: thanks everyone. closing bisect. :tada:
